description: Deliver the unified public REST API, DTOs, query services, and update services. This covers Tasks 4 and 6 from the plan: MapLocationQueryService for public read, InstalacionService and AreaVerdeService for restricted metadata updates, MapRestController with inventory and detail endpoints, and all associated DTOs.
steps: Create src/main/java/app/dto/LocationSummaryDto.java: record with mapKey, glbObjectName, locationType, displayName. Used in inventory listing.
Create src/main/java/app/dto/LocationDetailDto.java: record with mapKey, locationType, displayName, description, and a 'details' object (either InstalacionDetailDto or AreaVerdeDetailDto).
Create src/main/java/app/dto/InstalacionDetailDto.java: record with facilityType, useDescription, academicPrograms, floorCount, operationalStatus.

Create src/main/java/app/dto/InstalacionUpdateCommand.java: record with displayName, description, useDescription, academicPrograms, floorCount, operationalStatus. Add Bean Validation annotations (@NotBlank on displayName, @Size limits, @Min(1) on floorCount when present).
Create src/main/java/app/dto/AreaVerdeUpdateCommand.java: record with displayName, description, sector, surfaceArea. Add Bean Validation (@NotBlank on displayName, @DecimalMin('0') on surfaceArea).

Create src/main/java/app/service/MapLocationQueryService.java: constructor-injected with MapLocationRepository, InstalacionRepository, AreaVerdeRepository. Methods: getInventory() returns List<LocationSummaryDto> from active locations; getDetail(String mapKey) returns Optional<LocationDetailDto> by loading MapLocation and appropriate subtype; maps entities to DTOs.

Create src/main/java/app/service/InstalacionService.java: constructor-injected with MapLocationRepository and InstalacionRepository. Method: updateMetadata(String mapKey, InstalacionUpdateCommand cmd) loads location, verifies type is INSTALACION, updates only allowed display fields on MapLocation and Instalacion detail, saves transactionally. Throws appropriate exceptions for not-found, wrong-type, or optimistic lock conflict.

Create src/main/java/app/service/AreaVerdeService.java: constructor-injected with MapLocationRepository and AreaVerdeRepository. Method: updateMetadata(String mapKey, AreaVerdeUpdateCommand cmd) loads location, verifies type is AREA_VERDE, updates allowed fields, saves transactionally.

Create src/main/java/app/controller/rest/MapRestController.java: GET /api/map/locations returns List<LocationSummaryDto>; GET /api/map/locations/{mapKey} returns LocationDetailDto or 404 ProblemDetail. Use constructor injection, @RestController, proper @RequestMapping.

Create src/main/java/app/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java: @RestControllerAdvice handling LocationNotFoundException (404 ProblemDetail), LocationTypeMismatchException (400 ProblemDetail), OptimisticLockingFailureException (409 ProblemDetail).
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/map/locations returns JSON array of all active locations with mapKey, glbObjectName, locationType, displayName
GET /api/map/locations/{mapKey} returns unified detail DTO with type-specific details nested
InstalacionService.updateMetadata only modifies display/metadata fields, never identity fields
AreaVerdeService.updateMetadata only modifies display/metadata fields, never identity fields
Services reject updates to locations of wrong type
All services use constructor injection with final fields
verification: Read all service and controller source files to verify correct constructor injection pattern
Verify DTOs are records with appropriate fields
Verify exception handler maps to correct HTTP status codes
Verify update services do not modify mapKey, glbObjectName, locationType, or active fields
findings: All 13 files created and committed. Structural verification confirmed all internal and external imports resolve correctly. Cannot compile due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network (Maven Central unreachable). The app.exception package is picked up by the base 'app' component scan without needing explicit scanBasePackages entry.
